_comment: FIA 2026 Formula 1 power-unit + sporting constants. Single source of truth. Do NOT hard-code these values anywhere in src/. Sources: PU Technical Regulations Art. 5.4.1-5.4.13; Sporting Section B Issue 08 (Art. B7.1 Active Aero, B7.2 Overtake Mode); Technical Section C Issue 20 - both published 5 Aug 2026; post-Miami amendments applied.
regulation_issue: Sporting B Issue 08 / Technical C Issue 20, published 5 Aug 2026
power_to_propel_kw: min(350, 1800 - 5*v_kph) if v_kph < 340 else (6900 - 20*v_kph if v_kph < 345 else 0)

power_to_propel_params._comment: Numeric companion to power_to_propel_kw. FIA 2026 C5.2.8: 1800-5v below 340 km/h, 6900-20v from 340-345 km/h, zero above 345 km/h without Overtake Mode.

recharge_mj_per_lap._comment: Art. 5.4.9 Recharge ceiling variants [MJ/lap]. Standard race ceiling is 8.5; event notes may reduce it; qualifying uses its own cap; the Stewards may grant a conditional +0.5 MJ allowance; Safety Car and low-grip running use reduced caps. Code must select via RulesConfig.recharge_limit_mj(), never hard-code.

overtake_curve_kph._comment: MGU-K limit with Overtake Mode active (C5.2.8 + B7.2): the 340-345 taper is extended so power reaches zero at 355 km/h instead of 345.

fuel_rpm_params._comment: Numeric companion to fuel_rpm_formula_below_10500: fuel mass flow limit [kg/h] = slope*rpm + intercept, for rpm below the knee.

physics._comment: Vehicle/environment model parameters used by the deterministic SoC observer and the Tier-1 DP. These are modelling assumptions, NOT FIA constants; they are configurable so the estimate can be re-derived under different assumptions.
physics._harvest_note: Single calibration scalar. Set so that the observer's per-lap brake-only recovery at Melbourne matches the published figure of 2.9 MJ (f1briefing.com, 1 Jul 2026). It folds together rear-axle brake share, MGU-K power limiting and regen efficiency. Every other circuit's harvest then falls out of its own geometry.

dp._comment: Tier-1 dynamic-programming discretisation. `soc_bins` is the public/reporting resolution (0.1 MJ over the 4 MJ window). `solver_oversample` makes the internal DP grid that many times finer (0.01 MJ): a 10 m segment carries ~0.03 MJ, which is a third of a reporting bin and cannot be rounded to one without destroying the energy accounting.

deploy_weight_by_kind._comment: Share of the calibrated deployment duty applied by segment type. Teams deploy on the straights, so concentrating it there is what produces the ~2x-per-lap battery cycling.

points._comment: 2026 scoring used by the Overtake EV engine to price a position gain.
